findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: booking_handoff · Private data: list_routes, request_quote, search_aircraft_for_sale, get_aircraft_listing, request_aircraft_info · Public sink: request_quote, request_aircraft_info · Destructive: search_empty_legs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: booking_handoff · Private data: list_routes, request_quote, search_aircraft_for_sale, get_aircraft_listing, request_aircraft_info · Public sink: request_quote, request_aircraft_info · Destructive: search_empty_legs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
